page_title: ALM 0-3 ALA | Almeria v Alaves 26/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Dion Lopy (Almeria) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.
90+2' A cross into the box from Marc Pubill (Almeria) is cleared. Almeria have a corner.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Carlos Vicente will be replaced by Victor Parada Gonzalez (Alaves).
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) comes onto the pitch for Samu Omorodion.
88' 0 - 3 Goal! Carlos Benavidez provides Samu Omorodion (Alaves) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 0:3.
86' Lazaro (Almeria) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
86' Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. Almeria win a corner kick.
85' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
84' Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias who sees an offensive foul.
81' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
81' Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luka Romero (Almeria) is coming onto the pitch as Sergio Arribas cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Ander Guevara (Alaves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
78' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) replacing Andoni Gorosabel.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luis Rioja departs the field of play to be replaced by Alex Sola (Alaves).
78' Lazaro (Almeria) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
77' Antonio Sivera comes off his line to intercept the corner from Sergio Arribas (Almeria).

76' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Antonio Sivera stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. The linesman makes the right call and Almeria will have a corner.
75' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adrian Embarba trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lazaro (Almeria).
75' Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Almeria.
70' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Almeria.
69' 15:10 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.

67' Sergio Arribas floats a good corner into the box that Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
67' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
66' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Corner kick. Almeria will have an opportunity.
64' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Luis Maximiano comes off the line to clear the ball away.
62' Jon Guridi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
61' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

61' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Almeria force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' Great save! Adrian Embarba (Almeria) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Antonio Sivera.
57' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

57' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' A substitution has been made. Leo Baptistao is replaced by Marko Milovanovic (Almeria).
56' Gaizka Garitano has decided to substitute Edgar Gonzalez and he is replaced by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria).
56' Substitution. Sergio Akieme makes his way off the pitch and Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) comes on as his replacement.
52' 0 - 2 Goal! Luis Rioja (Alaves) lashes the penalty into the left side of the goal, giving the keeper no chance.
51' Luis Rioja (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
51' Luis Maximiano (Almeria) makes a slide tackle, but referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Alaves!
50' Almeria quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
50' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Almeria force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' Marc Pubill (Almeria) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45+1' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes the corner which is cleared.

45+1' Ander Guevara (Alaves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the right side of the goal, but Antonio Sivera makes a nice save.
43' Almeria are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
40' Jon Guridi (Alaves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' It looks like Dion Lopy (Almeria) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
36' The possession of the ball – 62:38.
34' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
34' Great teamplay by Almeria as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

32' Jon Guridi plays a lovely pass into Samu Omorodion (Alaves), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
30' Luis Rioja (Alaves) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
29' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sergio Arribas (Almeria) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.

28' Wasted effort! Dion Lopy (Almeria) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
28' The Almeria players are exchanging some short passes.
24' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
22' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) sends a cross into the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) takes a short corner kick.
22' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Almeria force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
20' Marc Pubill (Almeria) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
19' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
14' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
13' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
13' The injury to Lucas Robertone (Almeria) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.

12' Javi Lopez (Alaves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
10' 0 - 1 Samu Omorodion (Alaves) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable low shot into the middle of the net.
9' Almeria take a short corner kick.
9' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee blows his whistle, Almeria are awarded a corner kick.
9' Almeria failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. It will be a corner kick for Almeria.

9' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.
7' The Almeria players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Rafa Marin (Alaves) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
3' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
3' Alaves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
2' Wonderful movement by Alaves. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will officiate today.
